pages.text: The end of an anomaly is understanding it. Physics has done this before: infinities in quantum field theory looked like a disaster until $(thing)renormalisation$() showed they only meant the constants depend on the scale you measure at. A measured quantity G then obeys [μ∂/∂μ + β(g)∂/∂g + nγ]G = 0, and at a fixed point it scales as μ^{−nγ}: the anomaly is just an $(thing)anomalous dimension$(), a number in a deeper law.

Every stage of this branch was a piece of that: where it came from, how it copies, what system carries it, where it breaks the rules and by how much, how large it gets, how to hold it and how to cure it. With all of it, the $(item)Anomaly Resolution Engine$() resolves a catalogued, quarantined anomaly: $(item)Resolved Anomalies$(). A Local Law Violation with an Undecidable Kernel, renormalised, is resolved too: the broken law explained.

Resolved anomalies are understood law, and the endgame can use them: in the $(item)Axiom Distiller$() one with source code in Renormalised Essence makes $(item)Axiom Fragments$(), and in the $(item)Reality Compiler$() a Quarantine Field Matrix and a resolved anomaly make a $(item)Reality Anchor$() - other ways to both.$(br2)It was never abnormal. It was only not yet explained.
An anomaly explained: its strangeness measured, renormalised, and written back into the laws. It is just physics now. It always was.$(br2)Made in $(item)Anomaly Resolution Engine$().
A shard of a foundational rule. Mathematics is built on these; so is reality.$(br2)Made in $(item)Axiom Distiller$().
Keeps a patch of reality from being edited.$(br2)Made in $(item)Reality Compiler$().
